where.if: AND (c.case_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.owner_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.sql: c.id, c.case_no, c.title, c.status, c.current_revision_no, c.owner_name, c.created_at, c.updated_at, cr.id AS current_revision_id, cr.revision_no, cr.preconditions, cr.expected_result, cr.test_type, cr.priority, cr.execution_mode, cr.script_id, s.script_name, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dpm_requirement_case rc WHERE rc.test_case_id = c.id) AS requirement_count
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM dpm_test_case c LEFT JOIN dpm_test_case_revision cr ON cr.test_case_id = c.id AND cr.revision_no = c.current_revision_no LEFT JOIN dpm_test_script s ON s.id = cr.script_id
ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dpm_test_case c LEFT JOIN dpm_test_case_revision cr ON cr.test_case_id = c.id AND cr.revision_no = c.current_revision_no

SELECT FROM dpm_test_case c LEFT JOIN dpm_test_case_revision cr ON cr.test_case_id = c.id AND cr.revision_no = c.current_revision_no LEFT JOIN dpm_test_script s ON s.id = cr.script_id WHERE c.id = #{id}
SELECT id, case_no, title, status, current_revision_no, owner_name FROM dpm_test_case WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dpm_test_case (case_no, title, status, current_revision_no, owner_name) VALUES (#{caseNo}, #{title}, #{status}, 1, #{ownerName})
mapper.update: UPDATE dpm_test_case SET case_no = #{request.caseNo}, title = #{request.title}, status = #{request.status}, current_revision_no = #{revisionNo}, owner_name = #{request.ownerName}, updated_by = #{request.createdBy} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO dpm_test_case_revision (test_case_id, revision_no, preconditions, steps_json, expected_result, test_type, priority, execution_mode, script_id, script_revision_id, ai_instruction, test_data_json, change_note, created_by) VALUES (#{caseId}, #{revisionNo}, #{request.preconditions}, CAST(#{stepsJson} AS JSON), #{request.expectedResult}, #{request.testType}, #{request.priority}, #{request.executionMode}, #{request.scriptId}, (SELECT current_revision_id FROM dpm_test_script WHERE id = #{request.scriptId}), #{request.aiInstruction},
CAST(#{request.testDataJson} AS JSON)
NULL , #{request.changeNote}, #{request.createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT cr.id, cr.test_case_id, cr.revision_no, cr.preconditions, CAST(cr.steps_json AS CHAR) AS steps_json, cr.expected_result, cr.test_type, cr.priority, cr.execution_mode, cr.script_id, cr.script_revision_id, sr.script_version, cr.ai_instruction, CAST(cr.test_data_json AS CHAR) AS test_data_json, cr.change_note, cr.created_by, cr.created_at FROM dpm_test_case_revision cr LEFT JOIN dpm_test_script_revision sr ON sr.id = cr.script_revision_id WHERE cr.test_case_id = #{caseId} ORDER BY cr.revision_no DESC

SELECT cr.id, cr.test_case_id, cr.revision_no, cr.preconditions, CAST(cr.steps_json AS CHAR) AS steps_json, cr.expected_result, cr.test_type, cr.priority, cr.execution_mode, cr.script_id, cr.script_revision_id, sr.script_version, cr.ai_instruction, CAST(cr.test_data_json AS CHAR) AS test_data_json, cr.change_note, cr.created_by, cr.created_at FROM dpm_test_case_revision cr LEFT JOIN dpm_test_script_revision sr ON sr.id = cr.script_revision_id WHERE cr.test_case_id = #{caseId} AND cr.id = #{revisionId}

SELECT r.id AS requirement_id, r.version_id AS version_id, r.requirement_no, r.title, p.project_code, p.project_name, v.version_no, rc.coverage_type FROM dpm_requirement_case rc INNER JOIN dpm_requirement r ON r.id = rc.requirement_id INNER JOIN dpm_version v ON v.id = r.version_id INNER JOIN dpm_project p ON p.id = v.project_id WHERE rc.test_case_id = #{caseId} ORDER BY p.project_code, v.version_no, r.sort_order, r.requirement_no

SELECT r.id AS requirement_id, r.requirement_no, r.title, p.project_code, p.project_name, v.version_no FROM dpm_requirement r INNER JOIN dpm_version v ON v.id = r.version_id INNER JOIN dpm_project p ON p.id = v.project_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND r.version_id = #{versionId} ORDER BY p.project_code, v.version_no, r.sort_order, r.requirement_no
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dpm_requirement r WHERE 1 = 1 AND r.version_id = #{versionId}

SELECT r.id AS requirement_id, r.requirement_no, r.title, p.project_code, p.project_name, v.version_no FROM dpm_requirement r INNER JOIN dpm_version v ON v.id = r.version_id INNER JOIN dpm_project p ON p.id = v.project_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND r.version_id = #{versionId} ORDER BY p.project_code, v.version_no, r.sort_order, r.requirement_no, r.id LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT s.id, s.script_code AS scriptCode, s.script_name AS scriptName, s.enabled, s.current_revision_id AS currentRevisionId, r.script_language AS scriptLanguage, r.runtime_version AS runtimeVersion, r.script_version AS scriptVersion, r.source_type AS sourceType, r.source_path AS sourcePath, r.entry_point AS entryPoint, CAST(r.arguments_json AS CHAR) AS argumentsJson FROM dpm_test_script s LEFT JOIN dpm_test_script_revision r ON r.id = s.current_revision_id WHERE s.enabled = 1 ORDER BY s.script_name, s.id

SELECT s.id, s.script_code AS scriptCode, s.script_name AS scriptName, s.enabled, s.current_revision_id AS currentRevisionId, r.script_language AS scriptLanguage, r.runtime_version AS runtimeVersion, r.script_version AS scriptVersion, r.source_type AS sourceType, r.source_path AS sourcePath, r.entry_point AS entryPoint, CAST(r.arguments_json AS CHAR) AS argumentsJson FROM dpm_test_script s LEFT JOIN dpm_test_script_revision r ON r.id = s.current_revision_id WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.enabled = 1 FOR UPDATE
